entities.name: Moriok
entities.description: Human ethnic group of the Mephidross swamps of Mirrodin, nearly wiped out by the nim and Phyrexians.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: Swamps of Mirrodin where the Moriok lived.

entities.name: Nim
entities.description: Undead who attacked the Moriok after the Vanishing.

entities.name: Nim Onslaught
entities.description: Nim assault that decimated the Moriok.

entities.name: Vanishing
entities.description: Event after which the Moriok were targeted.

entities.name: Mirran Resistance
entities.description: Resistance a minuscule minority of Moriok joined.

entities.name: Disciples of Geth
entities.description: Most influential Moriok clan, centered around Ish Sah.

entities.name: Ghost Maw Clan
entities.description: Moriok clan following ghostly leaders in reliquaries made by the Bleak Coven.

entities.name: Black Blood Clan
entities.description: Clan who ate Glistening Dunes sludge.

entities.name: Gray Ladies Clan
entities.description: Matriarchal clan trading sons to the undead.

entities.name: Whisperer
entities.description: Black moon of Mirrodin revered by the Moriok.

events.summary: After the Vanishing the Nim Onslaught decimates the Moriok, leaving them easy prey for the New Phyrexians.
events.quote: The Nim Onslaught or Nim Massacre decimated the Moriok so they became an easy target for the New Phyrexians .

events.summary: Once Mirrodin becomes New Phyrexia, the Moriok are the first human race nearly extinct; compleated survivors are enslaved.
events.quote: the Moriok were the first human race to become nearly extinct

relations.quote: the Moriok found themselves targeted by Nim aggression
